description.value: Full-service RV resort on the Anarchist Mountain summit along Hwy 3, sitting above Okanagan valley heat with clear night skies and sage-scented air; tent sites are available at $35–45/night, and the Kettle Valley Rail Trail is accessible nearby.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched from summitrvresort.com and provides strong primary evidence. The site confirms operations at 6075 Highway BC-3, Bridesville, BC with phone +1-250-533-1111, tent sites, hot showers, laundry, and on-site bike rentals with Rail Trail access. Two notable discrepancies: OSM names it 'Summit RV Park' while the website consistently uses 'Summit RV Resort'; and OSM tags internet_access=no but the website explicitly lists 'Complimentary WiFi' and 'Basic WiFi' included in site rates — website takes precedence on both.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Summit RV Park' but website consistently uses 'Summit RV Resort' — OSM name appears outdated.
OSM tag internet_access=no contradicts website's explicit 'Complimentary WiFi' / 'Basic WiFi' included in all site rates — website value used as authoritative.
OSM record had no address or phone; both values sourced exclusively from the website contact page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate year-round campground on a major southern BC cycling corridor (Hwy 3) with tent sites, on-site bike rentals, and Kettle Valley Rail Trail access — a clear fit for the WWC directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: About page explicitly states 'Bike rentals are now available at our campground' and describes guided back-road farm tours; the Kettle Valley Railway Rail Trail is named as the primary on-site cycling route terminating in Rock Creek.

wow_evidence: tent sites, hot showers, laundry, and on-site bike rentals with Rail Trail access
